options.label: Unit sight blocking

values.label: Each unit's perimeter blocks
values.description: A unit in the way blocks sight across its whole outline, gaps between its models included. The target's own unit blocks only with its models.

values.label: Each model blocks
values.description: A unit in the way blocks sight only with its models' bodies, so a line can pass through the gaps between them.

options.description: How other units standing between a model and its target block its line of sight.

options.label: Line of sight method

values.label: Core line of sight
values.description: A model sees its target if a straight line from its eye level reaches the target without passing through terrain that blocks sight or another unit.

values.label: Hybrid True Line of Sight
values.description: Core line of sight, with each model given a size class by its Tough (Small, Medium, Large, Huge, Titanic). A model sees through a unit of a smaller class, through one no larger than itself when the target is larger than that unit, and through a unit standing lower when it stands on elevation.

options.description: How the game decides whether a model can see its target.

options.label: Melee separation

values.label: Separate units by 1"
values.description: After a melee in which neither unit was destroyed, the charging unit moves back 1" so the units are no longer in contact.

values.label: Units stay in contact
values.description: After a melee the units stay in contact. Both still activate, move, shoot and charge as normal, and may stay within 1" of a unit they were touching when they move.

options.description: Whether the units of a melee step apart once it is over.
